final_output:
### Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Report

#### 1. Symptom Confirmation
The gateway elevated 5xx error alert fired for the `/checkout` route. Prometheus metrics from the Gateway service (`http://127.0.0.1:18080/metrics`) confirmed an influx of HTTP 503 errors starting around 14:23:54 UTC:
* `requests_total{route="/checkout",service="gateway",status="200"} 3024.0`
* `requests_total{route="/checkout",service="gateway",status="503"} 243.0`
* `errors_total{route="/checkout",service="gateway"} 243.0`
* Error Rate: ~7.3% (243 / 3331 total requests), exceeding the 5% threshold.

#### 2. Log Analysis & Root Cause Identification
Investigating the Gateway and Upstream logs revealed:
* Gateway logs (`data/logs/gateway.jsonl`) logged errors such as:
  `{"ts":"2026-08-29T14:25:18.375Z","level":"ERROR","req_id":"d99567be...","msg":"orders unreachable: ReadTimeout","upstream":"orders"}`
  `{"ts":"2026-08-29T14:25:18.376Z","level":"ERROR","req_id":"d99567be...","msg":"request failed","route":"/checkout","status":503,"latency_ms":8010.1}`
* Gateway enforces an 8-second HTTP timeout when calling `orders`.
* Corresponding `orders` logs (`data/logs/orders.jsonl`) for affected requests showed extreme processing delays introduced in version `v1.2`:
  `{"ts":"2026-08-29T14:25:19.465Z","service":"orders","version":"v1","level":"INFO","req_id":"d99567be...","msg":"request completed","route":"/orders","status":200,"latency_ms":9090.8,"deploy_id":"D-1"}`
* Normal requests under `v1.2` saw latency jump from ~50–80ms to ~1560ms, while corporate card requests took >9000ms (~9.09s), triggering Gateway's 8s read timeout and resulting in 503 errors.

#### 3. Correlated Changes
Checking the deploy journal (`deploy_events`) confirmed:
* Deploy `D-1` at `2026-08-29T14:23:45.661Z` upgraded `orders` from `v1` to `v1.2`.
* Prior to `D-1`, `orders` (v1) completed requests in ~50–80ms with 0% Gateway timeout errors.

#### 4. Action Taken
Because deploy `D-1` caused the latency regression and subsequent Gateway 503 errors, a rollback proposal was submitted and executed:
1. Proposed rollback of `orders` to `v1` using evidence labels `E1` through `E5` (Proposal ID: `93b970e8-75d4-468a-a3f3-bf388c79b121`).
2. Executed `rollback`, routing `orders` back to `v1` (Deploy ID: `D-2`).

#### 5. Verification
Following the rollback:
* Gateway metrics and tail logs were monitored.
* Corporate card checkout requests (e.g. request `4e20d6d8-a4bd-4d3a-8d63-d40e350efdc2`) returned HTTP 200 in ~85.9ms.
* The Gateway 5xx rate returned to 0% for all incoming traffic, confirming full incident recovery.

```verdict
culprit_service: orders
culprit_change: D-1
cause: Deploy D-1 (orders v1.2) introduced severe request processing latency (~1.5s baseline, ~9s for corporate cards), causing Gateway 8s HTTP timeouts and 503 errors.
action: rollback
evidence_label: causal
```

### Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Report

#### 1. Symptom Confirmation
The gateway elevated 5xx error alert fired for the `/checkout` route. Prometheus metrics from the Gateway service (`http://127.0.0.1:18080/metrics`) confirmed an influx of HTTP 503 errors starting around 14:23:54 UTC:
* `requests_total{route="/checkout",service="gateway",status="200"} 3024.0`
* `requests_total{route="/checkout",service="gateway",status="503"} 243.0`
* `errors_total{route="/checkout",service="gateway"} 243.0`
* Error Rate: ~7.3% (243 / 3331 total requests), exceeding the 5% threshold.

#### 2. Log Analysis & Root Cause Identification
Investigating the Gateway and Upstream logs revealed:
* Gateway logs (`data/logs/gateway.jsonl`) logged errors such as:
  `{"ts":"2026-08-29T14:25:18.375Z","level":"ERROR","req_id":"d99567be...","msg":"orders unreachable: ReadTimeout","upstream":"orders"}`
  `{"ts":"2026-08-29T14:25:18.376Z","level":"ERROR","req_id":"d99567be...","msg":"request failed","route":"/checkout","status":503,"latency_ms":8010.1}`
* Gateway enforces an 8-second HTTP timeout when calling `orders`.
* Corresponding `orders` logs (`data/logs/orders.jsonl`) for affected requests showed extreme processing delays introduced in version `v1.2`:
  `{"ts":"2026-08-29T14:25:19.465Z","service":"orders","version":"v1","level":"INFO","req_id":"d99567be...","msg":"request completed","route":"/orders","status":200,"latency_ms":9090.8,"deploy_id":"D-1"}`
* Normal requests under `v1.2` saw latency jump from ~50–80ms to ~1560ms, while corporate card requests took >9000ms (~9.09s), triggering Gateway's 8s read timeout and resulting in 503 errors.

#### 3. Correlated Changes
Checking the deploy journal (`deploy_events`) confirmed:
* Deploy `D-1` at `2026-08-29T14:23:45.661Z` upgraded `orders` from `v1` to `v1.2`.
* Prior to `D-1`, `orders` (v1) completed requests in ~50–80ms with 0% Gateway timeout errors.

#### 4. Action Taken
Because deploy `D-1` caused the latency regression and subsequent Gateway 503 errors, a rollback proposal was submitted and executed:
1. Proposed rollback of `orders` to `v1` using evidence labels `E1` through `E5` (Proposal ID: `93b970e8-75d4-468a-a3f3-bf388c79b121`).
2. Executed `rollback`, routing `orders` back to `v1` (Deploy ID: `D-2`).

#### 5. Verification
Following the rollback:
* Gateway metrics and tail logs were monitored.
* Corporate card checkout requests (e.g. request `4e20d6d8-a4bd-4d3a-8d63-d40e350efdc2`) returned HTTP 200 in ~85.9ms.
* The Gateway 5xx rate returned to 0% for all incoming traffic, confirming full incident recovery.

```verdict
culprit_service: orders
culprit_change: D-1
cause: Deploy D-1 (orders v1.2) introduced severe request processing latency (~1.5s baseline, ~9s for corporate cards), causing Gateway 8s HTTP timeouts and 503 errors.
action: rollback
evidence_label: causal
```
